page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.36xlarge is a compute-focused instance within the High Clock Speed family running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a base clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 144 dedicated vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding an allocation of 2.67 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

Hardware integration features a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, accommodating large network data transfers between cloud resources. The configuration contains no discrete GPU accelerators and includes no bundled local storage, necessitating external network-attached storage for persistent operating system and data volumes. Additionally, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its high clock speed and dense core count paired with a relatively low memory-to-core ratio, the instance is qualitatively optimized for CPU-heavy tasks over RAM-heavy caching or local I/O intensive databases. It is best configured for workloads such as large-scale software builds, CI/CD pipelines, parallel simulations, compute-bound batch processing, and high-throughput application tier processing.
